intro: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill wants to know more about the Kirin Tor, whose city Archimonde destroyed and who have now rebuilt Dalaran on the Dark Lady's very doorstep. You are to search the Kirin Tor camps for something that can get the Horde into the city unnoticed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.
That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!
While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.
But we have work to do before it's safe to use this.
